original_test_policy: 2011-11-11 through 2011-12-08 stays previously exposed diagnostic; never reevaluated or used to select these models.
limitations: Historical targets belonged to prior training periods; predeclared analysis is exploratory, not an untouched holdout.
Eight folds, one retailer, 2009–2011; no cross-company or MRDIY predictive validation.
Observed sales are a demand proxy and can be inventory-censored.
Transaction-time availability is assumed; historical ingestion timestamps unavailable.
Source completeness assumption permits zero recorded sales on calendar dates; does not establish latent demand.
No real inventory, arrivals, shortage outcomes, operational calibration or causal savings evidence.
Point selection minimizes seven-day absolute error; it need not yield an unbiased mean or optimal inventory decision.
Empirical intervals are evaluated, not guaranteed calibrated. Marginal daily quantiles are not jointly coherent demand trajectories.

protocol_summary.interpretation: Exploratory retrospective rolling-origin evidence. Historical targets belonged to the prior study training period; not an untouched external or prospective holdout.
protocol_summary.source_target: Positive recorded transaction sales in original UCI Online Retail II; demand proxy, not latent demand
protocol_summary.old_test_policy: 2011-11-11 through 2011-12-08 stays previously exposed diagnostic; never reevaluated or used to select these models.
protocol_summary.eligibility_policy: Freeze fold SKU catalog from days strictly before validation. Retain discontinued/zero-test items; no future-based exclusions.
protocol_summary.point_selection: Lowest validation seven-day cumulative WAPE, exact ties by listed candidate order. If validation actual total is zero, lowest absolute error. Select each fold solely on its preceding validation window. No test-based replacement or grid tuning.
protocol_summary.primary_metric: WAPE of seven-day total per item and non-overlapping weekly origin
protocol_summary.quantile_selection: Lowest mean validation pinball loss over q0.1/0.5/0.9 on seven-day totals; ties choose smaller window. Empirical inverted-CDF order statistic, no outcome-based recalibration.
protocol_summary.uncertainty: 400 paired bootstrap replicates; globally shared SKU resampling and fold-block resampling preserve seven-day forecast trajectories. Descriptive, only eight fold blocks and one retailer.
protocol_summary.synthetic_inventory_policy: Any stock, arrivals, cost, lead time and actual stockout labels remain separately declared hypothetical inputs. No actual shortage accuracy or savings claim.
protocol_summary.resource_policy: One process, one BLAS thread, NumPy-only, no GPU or paid API.
protocol_summary.promotion_policy: No operational model promotion from this exposed-data study. Freeze a future candidate only after descriptive results; require unseen operational transaction/stock/arrival evaluation before deployment claims.
